# Intent: Contractors can see their claim report status without phoning us

## Problem
Restoration contractors phone the office to ask whether a claim report has been sent to the insurer. Each call costs about ten minutes.

## Proposed outcome
A contractor opens one page and sees each report's status: drafted, sent, or queried by the insurer.

## Affected users and systems
Contractors (read only), office staff, the RestoreAssist reports module.

## Constraints
No new login system. Australian English. Must work on a phone on site.

## Open questions
Do insurers expose a status we can read, or do we only know what we sent?
